stays_and_why: TilemapPanel casts of gSceneCamera: shared headers type it as another camera view
position pointer to the stack struct (without it agbcc keeps the 6-byte struct in registers); (u8)animation casts give the ROM's second register copy
inline kind predicate: ROM materializes each comparison as a bool; plain || or switch does not
flag accessors and clear helper: ROM loads the s32 mask before the byte and materializes the test; plain &= folds the mask to 0xFE
do/while with break is plain C; for/while forms rotate the loop differently
do/while(0) around the remainder: without it 'cell' outranks 'value' in register allocation (priority 7368 vs 4375)
plain do/while with break; for form rotates differently
s16 view of modifierIdsBytes: shared header types it u8[8]
halfword read through the reused state pointer: a local or member read lets cse derive the address from the earlier offset
(u16)color shifts and a second *src read: other color types change the extraction shifts or register choice
index loaded then reduced in two statements (one expression adds a register copy)
